records.jp: 愛央、少しいいかしら？
records.en_original: Ao, do you have a bit of time now?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, do you have a bit of time now?
records.en: Ao, do you have a bit of time now?

records.jp: うん、いいよ！
records.en_original: Yeah, sure!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, sure!
records.en: Yeah, sure!

records.jp: それじゃあ、ちょっと来てもらえる？
records.en_original: Could you join me over here?
records.en_auxiliary: Could you join me over here?
records.en: Could you join me over here?

records.jp: 美弦さん、あの、これは……
records.en_original: Mio, um, this is...
records.en_auxiliary: Mio, um, this is...
records.en: Mio-san, um, this is...

records.jp: 普段頑張っている愛央に、何かしてあげたくなったの
records.en_original: You always work so hard for us, I wanted to do something for you.
records.en_auxiliary: You always work so hard for us, I wanted to do something for you.
records.en: I wanted to do something for you, Ao, since you always work so hard.

records.jp: あはは、ちょっと恥ずかしいかも
records.en_original: Hahaha, this is a little embarrassing...
records.en_auxiliary: Hahaha, this is a little embarrassing...
records.en: Hahaha, this is a little embarrassing...

records.jp: 本当は、少し聞いてほしいことがあって
records.en_original: Though truthfully, I also wanted to tell you something.
records.en_auxiliary: Though truthfully, I also wanted to tell you something.
records.en: The truth is, there is also something I want you to hear.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: Okay.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay.
records.en: Okay.

records.jp: ……私、自分のフラグメントが<CR>砕けてしまったことがあるの
records.en_original: I...once destroyed my own Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: I...once destroyed my own Fragment.
records.en: ...There was a time when my own Fragment<CR>was shattered.

records.jp: ……私、自分のフラグメントを<CR>失くしたことがあるの
records.en_original: I...once lost my own Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: I...once lost my own Fragment.
records.en: ...There was a time when I lost<CR>my own Fragment.

records.jp: えっ！？　大丈夫なの、それ？
records.en_original: What?! Isn't that super bad?
records.en_auxiliary: What?! Isn't that super bad?
records.en: What?! Isn't that super bad?

records.jp: いいえ。記憶も感情も失って……<CR>ぼーっと生きる日々が続いていたわ
records.en_original: It is. I lost both my memories and my feelings. There was a time when I lived life in a daze.
records.en_auxiliary: It is. I lost both my memories and my feelings. There was a time when I lived life in a daze.
records.en: No. I lost both my memories and emotions...<CR>and spent my days living in a daze.

records.jp: 陽桜莉の前からも姿を消して……。<CR>一時期、行方不明になった
records.en_original: I left Hiori. I was completely lost for a long time.
records.en_auxiliary: I left Hiori. I was completely lost for a long time.
records.en: I disappeared from Hiori's life as well...<CR>For a time, I was missing.

records.jp: でも、今こうして美弦さんがいるってことは……<CR>全部解決してるってことだよね？
records.en_original: But you're here now. That means that everything worked out in the end, right?
records.en_auxiliary: But you're here now. That means that everything worked out in the end, right?
records.en: But since you're here now, Mio-san...<CR>that means everything was resolved, right?

records.jp: でも、今の美弦さんはそんな風には見えないから……<CR>全部解決してるってことだよね？
records.en_original: But you're not like that anymore. So...all's well that ends well, right?
records.en_auxiliary: But you're not like that anymore. So...all's well that ends well, right?
records.en: But you don't look that way now, Mio-san...<CR>so that means everything was resolved, right?

records.jp: ……私と陽桜莉のココロトープが一つなのは、<CR>どうしてだと思う？
records.en_original: Why do you think that Hiori and I share a Heartscape?
records.en_auxiliary: Why do you think that Hiori and I share a Heartscape?
records.en: ...Why do you think Hiori and I<CR>share a single Heartscape?

records.en_original: Uh...
records.en_auxiliary: Uh...
records.en: Uh...

records.jp: 私のフラグメントは、陽桜莉から借りてるものなのよ
records.en_original: My Fragment is borrowed. I received it from Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: My Fragment is borrowed. I received it from Hiori.
records.en: My Fragment is something I borrowed from Hiori.

records.jp: っ！
records.en_original: Wha—?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wha—?!
records.en: Wha—?!

records.jp: 自分が誰かもわからず、さまよってる私を<CR>陽桜莉は見つけてくれて……
records.en_original: Hiori found me when I was lost, simply going through the motions of living...
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori found me when I was lost, simply going through the motions of living...
records.en: Hiori found me while I was wandering,<CR>not even knowing who I was...

records.jp: そして陽桜莉は、ユズたちの力を借りて、<CR>自分の想いの一部を私に分け与えたの
records.en_original: So she borrowed some of Yuzu and Lime's power, and gave me a part of her own emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: So she borrowed some of Yuzu and Lime's power, and gave me a part of her own emotions.
records.en: Then Hiori borrowed Yuzu and the others' power<CR>and shared part of her own feelings with me.

records.jp: 強い絆で結ばれてるから……想いが繋がっているから、<CR>こんなことができたってユズは言っていたけれど……
records.en_original: Yuzu told her it was possible because of the deep connection our emotions and memories had.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu told her it was possible because of the deep connection our emotions and memories had.
records.en: Yuzu said it was possible because we are bound by a strong bond...<CR>because our feelings are connected...

records.jp: なんにせよ、私が今ここにいられるのは、<CR>陽桜莉のおかげ
records.en_original: At any rate, it's thanks to Hiori that I'm still here.
records.en_auxiliary: At any rate, it's thanks to Hiori that I'm still here.
records.en: In any case, I can be here now<CR>because of Hiori.

records.jp: ……どうしてそれを、私に？
records.en_original: ...Why are you telling me all this?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Why are you telling me all this?
records.en: ...Why are you telling me all this?

records.jp: ……愛央には全部、知っておいてほしいって<CR>思ったから……
records.en_original: I wanted you to know everything.
records.en_auxiliary: I wanted you to know everything.
records.en: ...Because I wanted you, Ao,<CR>to know everything...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん。今日もアレ、やるよね？
records.en_original: Hey, Ao. You ready?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Ao. You ready?
records.en: Ao-chan. We're doing that again today, right?

records.jp: うん。お願い
records.en_original: Yeah, let's do it.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, let's do it.
records.en: Yeah. Please.
